name="06 - Notes & Cardinality Decisions"> <mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="800" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1600" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="notes1" value="<div style="font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;padding:14px;">
<h2 style="margin-top:0;color:#1D4ED8;">Vaka ERD — Applied decisions</h2>
<ul>
<li><b>task_locations:</b> task_id is no longer UNIQUE. Each task can have multiple ordered locations; location_type and stop_order are required.</li>
<li><b>tasks:</b> reposted_from_task_id is a nullable self-referencing FK to tasks.task_id. CANCELLED and EXPIRED remain terminal; reposting creates a new task.</li>
<li><b>assignments:</b> travel_started_at and work_started_at are distinct nullable timestamps. UNIQUE(task_id) is included to enforce the explicitly requested tasks 1 : 0..1 assignments cardinality. bid_id is also UNIQUE.</li>
<li><b>cancellation_requests:</b> records requester, stage, decision status, escrow snapshot, compensation/refund/platform amounts, policy rule, and settlement timestamps.</li>
<li><b>financial_transactions:</b> cancellation_request_id is a nullable FK so cancellation-related financial movements can be traced without forcing every transaction to belong to a cancellation.</li>
<li><b>escrows:</b> assignment_id remains UNIQUE, enforcing assignments 1 : 0..1 escrows.</li>
<li><b>reviews-only scope:</b> only the reviews table is included from the complaints/arbitration area; no dispute/arbitration tables are added.</li>
<li><b>Preserved:</b> the remaining source inventory tables, fields, key annotations, and constraints are retained unless affected by the changes above.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Enum values explicitly supplied</h3>
<p><b>cancellation_requests.work_stage_at_request:</b> NOT_STARTED, TRAVEL_STARTED, WORK_STARTED</p>
<p><b>cancellation_requests.status:</b> REQUESTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, SETTLED</p>
<h3>Implementation note</h3>
<p>Validate the UNIQUE(task_id) rule with the team before implementing migrations if historical/retry assignments must be retained for a single task. It is present here because the requested final relationship states tasks 1 : 0..1 assignments.</p>
</div>" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#94A3B8;strokeWidth=1.2;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="50" y="40" width="1450" height="800" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
